mcp_tools.name: backend_engineering_advice
mcp_tools.title: Backend engineering advice
mcp_tools.description: Submits a backend-engineering evidence manifest (API contract, boundary validation, idempotency, error taxonomy, jobs and queues, data safety, observability) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_READY / NOT_PRODUCTION_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed error-taxonomy coverage against the skill's five named categories and checks gated on declared mutating operations, migrations and async jobs, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The backend-engineering evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

jobs.description: Jobs and queues evidence (gated on has_async_jobs).

data.description: Data-safety evidence, including migrations (gated on has_migrations).

expect.notes: All checks pass; computed_spot_checks: mutating_operation_count=1, taxonomy_categories_missing=[], computed_status=within_stated_limits_on_declared_evidence
